proof_body:
by
  intro F f a L hu hL
  have hC : CauchySeq L := by
    refine Metric.cauchySeq_iff.2 fun ε hε => ?_
    have hε4 : 0 < ε / 4 := by positivity
    obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.1 (Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.1 hu (ε / 4) hε4)
    refine ⟨K, fun m hm n hn => ?_⟩
    have h1 := (hL m).eventually (Metric.ball_mem_nhds (L m) hε4)
    have h2 := (hL n).eventually (Metric.ball_mem_nhds (L n) hε4)
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hm1, hn1⟩ := (eventually_mem_nhdsWithin.and (h1.and h2)).exists
    have a1 := hK m hm x hx
    have a2 := hK n hn x hx
    have b1 := Metric.mem_ball.1 hm1
    have b2 := Metric.mem_ball.1 hn1
    have t1 := dist_triangle (L m) (F m x) (L n)
    have t2 := dist_triangle (F m x) (f x) (L n)
    have t3 := dist_triangle (f x) (F n x) (L n)
    rw [dist_comm (L m) (F m x)] at t1
    rw [dist_comm (F m x) (f x)] at t2
    linarith
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := cauchySeq_tendsto_of_complete hC
  refine ⟨l, hl, ?_⟩
  have hf : TendstoUniformlyOnFilter F f Filter.atTop (nhdsWithin a {a}ᶜ) :=
    (tendstoUniformlyOn_iff_tendstoUniformlyOnFilter.1 hu).mono_right (by
      exact inf_le_right)
  exact hf.tendsto_of_eventually_tendsto (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hL) hl
target_source: ∀ (F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a : ℝ) (L : ℕ → ℝ), TendstoUniformlyOn F f Filter.atTop {a}ᶜ → (∀ n, Filter.Tendsto (F n) (nhdsWithin a {a}ᶜ) (nhds (L n))) → ∃ l : ℝ, Filter.Tendsto L Filter.atTop (nhds l) ∧ Filter.Tendsto f (nhdsWithin a {a}ᶜ) (nhds l)
